scope: Actual saved-model provenance, optimizer arithmetic, checkpoint selection and serialization; separately released development PDE diagnostic permitted.
limitations: No neural/JAX/native execution, optimization, new solve or validation access.
Saved objective and gradients not recomputed against teacher arrays; saved modal metric aggregation only.
Adam inter-step updates and sampled minibatch gradients not replayed.
Rejected trial parameter arrays not retained; their Armijo decisions replayed from recorded objective and independently derived direction.
Accepted rederived vectors allow floating-point BLAS roundoff; actual checkpoint/accepted-row hashes remain exact.
Training objective is not full-field flow accuracy or physical admission.
